decisive_items: pain localized to the V2 and V3 distributions of the left trigeminal nerve

response.rationale: Classic trigeminal neuralgia features (electric-shock pain, V2/V3 distribution, trigger by jaw movement) are fully present. Vaccine timing is a possible association but not required for diagnosis; R2 is the specific clinical syndrome, while R1 adds an etiologic qualifier not supported by confirmatory evidence.

rejected.why: Temporal link to vaccine is suggestive but not diagnostic; no evidence of vaccine-induced mechanism beyond timing, and typical TN features dominate.
